ours.spec: At the signal hour, take the day's range over the session window (hours before range_start, or [range_start, range_end)); dist = max(1.2 x ATR(atr_n), range span). The selector names the window: asia = hours before 7; london_am = [10,13) signalled at 13; ny_open = [13,14) at 14; afternoon = [14,17) at 17.
